screen.cloudstorage-helper.amount.title: Take From Cloud Storage
config.cloudstorage-helper.title: Cloud Storage Helper
config.cloudstorage-helper.comment.enabl: Hides cloud storage counts in item manager lists when disabled.
config.cloudstorage-helper.comment.fontS: Sets the scale of the cloud count text.
config.cloudstorage-helper.comment.xOffs: Adjusts the horizontal position of the cloud count text.
config.cloudstorage-helper.comment.yOffs: Adjusts the vertical position of the cloud count text.
config.cloudstorage-helper.comment.showC: Shows successfully parsed cloud storage responses in chat.
config.cloudstorage-helper.comment.lastI: The amount preselected when opening the custom take screen.
config.cloudstorage-helper.comment.reiEn: Shows counts and enables quick actions in the REI item list.
config.cloudstorage-helper.comment.jeiEn: Shows counts and enables quick actions in the JEI item list.
config.cloudstorage-helper.comment.litem: Allows quick-taking items for the Litematica schematic block under the crosshair.
config.cloudstorage-helper.comment.refre: Sends ci textlist and refreshes the local cloud storage cache.
config.cloudstorage-helper.comment.put:
Sends ci put to open the server cloud storage deposit screen.
Default key: B.
config.cloudstorage-helper.comment.openC:
Opens the Cloud Storage Helper MaLiLib configuration screen where every action key can be viewed and changed.
Default key: A + Y.
config.cloudstorage-helper.comment.takeO:
Action: takes one item from cloud storage while hovering a JEI or REI entry.
Default key: Shift + left mouse.
The recipe screen will not open.
config.cloudstorage-helper.comment.takeS:
Action: takes one stack from cloud storage while hovering a JEI or REI entry.
Default key: Shift + right mouse.
If fewer items are stored, all available items are taken and the recipe screen will not open.
config.cloudstorage-helper.comment.openA:
Action: opens the amount input screen while hovering a JEI or REI entry.
Default key: middle mouse.
Choose between taking items or shulker boxes.
config.cloudstorage-helper.comment.quick:
Action: quickly takes items for the dropped item, block, or Litematica schematic block under the screen-center crosshair.
Default key: Shift + middle mouse.
If fewer items are stored, all available items are taken.
